gloss: the actual exam; the main examination

definitions.gloss: the actual exam; the main examination; the real test
definitions.explanation: The official examination itself, as opposed to a practice test, a mock exam, or a makeup sitting. The {本|ほん} marks it as the genuine occasion on which the result counts.

examples.japanese: {本試験|ほんしけん}は{来月|らいげつ}だ。
examples.english: The actual exam is next month.

examples.japanese: {模擬|もぎ}{試験|しけん}より{本試験|ほんしけん}のほうが{難|むずか}しかった。
examples.english: The actual exam was harder than the mock exam.

examples.japanese: {本試験|ほんしけん}を{受|う}けられなかった{学生|がくせい}は、{追試|ついし}を{受|う}けることになっている。
examples.english: Students who could not sit the actual exam are to take a makeup test.

notes:
{本|ほん} (main, actual, this very) + {試験|しけん} (examination). The same {本|ほん} appears in {本番|ほんばん} (the real performance) and {本大会|ほんたいかい} (the main tournament).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本試験|ほんしけん}を{受|う}ける: to sit the actual exam
- {本試験|ほんしけん}に{向|む}けて: in preparation for the actual exam
- {本試験|ほんしけん}{当日|とうじつ}: the day of the exam

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {追試|ついし}: makeup exam — taken later by those who missed or failed the main one
- {模擬試験|もぎしけん}: mock exam — practice under exam conditions, results do not count
- {本番|ほんばん}: the real thing — broader, used of performances and live broadcasts as well as tests
